summary.headline: Adani Green FY26: energy sales up 34% to 37.6 BU and 5.1 GW added, but ~INR 1,300-1,500 crore EBITDA lost to curtailment.
summary.overview: FY26 power supply revenue rose 22% YoY to INR 11,602 crore and EBITDA grew 23% to INR 10,865 crore, at a 91.2% margin. Operating portfolio reached 19.3 GW after 5.1 GW of greenfield additions in the year. Management said curtailment and evacuation constraints cost about INR 500 crore of EBITDA in FY26, with a further INR 800-1,000 crore lost on merchant realisations versus contract rates. Battery storage is the main hedge: about 3 GWh was installed in Khavda by late April 2026, with 10 GWh+ targeted for FY27. FY27 solar/wind addition is guided at 4.5-5 GW, all under PPAs.

financial_highlights.metric: EBITDA lost to curtailment in FY26

segments.name: Renewable power (solar, wind, hybrid)
segments.commentary: 19.3 GW operating: 9.7 GW under 100% PPA, 5.3 GW infirm but expected to convert to PPA by Dec 2026 (some by Mar 2027), and 4.2 GW pure merchant to be contracted ASAP. Khavda hosts 9.4 GW operational.

segments.name: Battery energy storage (BESS)
segments.commentary: About 1.4 GWh added in Khavda in FY26 and about 3 GWh installed by late April 2026. Plan to commission 10+ GWh in FY27 at about INR 1.5 crore per MWh, roughly INR 15,000 crore capex; management targets about INR 25 lakh EBITDA per MWh.

segments.name: Pumped hydro storage
segments.commentary: Maiden 500 MW project at Chitravathi (Andhra Pradesh) targeted for completion in FY27.

guidance_outlook: FY27 capacity addition of 4.5-5 GW, all PPA-backed; management is capable of 7-8 GW but is pacing execution to evacuation.
Battery storage commissioning of 10+ GWh in FY27 on a 3-hour configuration; FY28 BESS run-rate to be set after FY27 learnings.
Khavda evacuation expected to add 7 GW by Dec 2026 and a further 7 GW by Mar 2027 (+/-3-4 months).
FY27 capex guided at INR 40,000-42,000 crore, with the number possibly reaching about INR 45,000 crore.
Solar PPA contracting range INR 2.60-2.80/kWh and wind INR 3.70-3.80/kWh; management expects downward pressure on the 8.9% blended rate.
Target of more than 90% of capacity under long-term contracts retained; 50 GW by 2030 target reaffirmed, with no FY28-29 guidance yet.
capex_capacity: FY26: 5.1 GW added; cumulative operating portfolio 19.3 GW; Khavda 9.4 GW operational with 9 GW of transmission active.
Battery storage: about 1.3 GW added in last 3-4 months; about 3 GWh installed in Khavda by late April 2026; 10+ GWh targeted by end FY27.
Chitravathi 500 MW pumped hydro to be completed in the coming year.
Execution capability 7-8 GW a year; FY27 execution limited to 4.5-5 GW by evacuation constraints.
Long-term goals: 50 GW by 2030, including about 5 GW of additional RE and 5-6 GW of PSP over five years, with batteries on top.
demand_pricing: Average blended PPA rate about INR 3.10/kWh; new solar contracting at INR 2.60-2.80 and wind at INR 3.70-3.80.
Curtailment: about INR 500 crore EBITDA lost in FY26; further INR 800-1,000 crore lost on merchant realisation versus contract rates. Management expects this to be recovered over the next 1-2 years.
Solar CUF in Khavda above 27% before curtailment; wind CUF about 29-30%. Curtailment cut CUF by about 2.5-3%, mainly in solar.
C&I sales are handled by sister company Adani Energy Solutions at arm's-length market rates; AESL has about 5 GW of renewable sign-ups per the call.
Group RE pipeline: 28 GW signed PPA capacity; Adani Energy Solutions is the end-to-end energy solution provider.

qa_highlights.question: What EBITDA was lost in FY26 from curtailment and low merchant prices, and what is the potential?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR 500 crore lost to curtailment, plus INR 800-1,000 crore at current contract rates versus last year's realisations, for a total of about INR 1,300-1,500 crore that is not expected to recur.

qa_highlights.question: How will the 5.3 GW of infirm capacity convert to PPAs, and how is evacuation planned?
qa_highlights.answer: Conversion is expected incrementally by Dec 2026, with some remaining until Mar 2027. Management is pacing execution to evacuation, with 14-15 GW of Khavda evacuation expected over 12-15 months.

qa_highlights.question: How is FY27 capex going to be, and what are the battery specs?
qa_highlights.answer: Capex guided at INR 40,000-42,000 crore, with upside to about INR 45,000 crore. Batteries are 3-hour systems, with 10+ GWh at about INR 1.5 crore per MWh, roughly INR 15,000 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Will the 50 GW by 2030 target change, and is FY28 execution going to jump?
qa_highlights.answer: No FY28/FY29 guidance yet; management will guide towards the end of FY27. Execution could rise if evacuation opens as expected, but management said the target is still being pursued.

qa_highlights.question: Is Adani Green still participating in renewable tenders, and what is the C&I arrangement?
qa_highlights.answer: AGEL is not directly chasing C&I; AESL contracts with customers at market-tested rates. More than 90% of installed capacity will still be under long-term contracts.

qa_highlights.question: Is curtailment behind the company, and how does the Khavda CUF look?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said curtailment cannot be declared permanently over, but battery capacity is the hedge. Khavda solar CUF was above 27% before curtailment, and curtailment cut CUF by about 2.5-3%.

risks_watch: Transmission and evacuation timing: 7 GW Khavda by Dec 2026 and 7 GW by Mar 2027, with +/-3-4 months margin of error.
Capital flexibility and supply chain for BESS scale-up to 10+ GWh in FY27.
Pricing pressure: blended tariff of INR 3.10/kWh is expected to decline, with new solar and wind contracts at lower rates.
Infirm (merchant) capacity of 5.3 GW plus 4.2 GW pure merchant must convert to PPAs by Dec 2026 to March 2027.
Related-party arrangements with Adani Energy Solutions, including market-tested rate setting and the 742 MW Khavda capacity built for group companies.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth, execution and BESS build-out, but cautious on curtailment: management said it cannot be declared permanently resolved. It was evasive on FY28-29 capacity guidance and on Adani Power's RTC bid, which it referred to that company's call.
key_quotes: So, we've lost about INR 500 crores of EBITDA in the past year on account of curtailment.
We expect to commission north of 10,000 megawatt hours or 10 gigawatt hours in this coming year.
So just being very honest and frank with you, I don't think that one or anyone can say that this issue is permanently behind us.
